```{r,echo=F}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(here)
library(readr)
library(stringr)

baseline <- read_csv("../data/Stimulated/baseline_survey_data.csv")
endline <- read_csv("../data/Stimulated/endline_survey_data.csv")
assignment <- read_csv("../data/Stimulated/assignment_data.csv")
```
### MERGE

```{r}
# Merge three datasets and only keep participants who finished both baseline and endline surveys 
data <- assign %>% 
  left_join(baseline_data, by = "participant_id") %>% 
  inner_join(endline_data, by = "participant_id") %>% 
  mutate(
    ad_group = case_when(
      ad_group == 0 ~ "Control",
      ad_group == 1 ~ "Reason",
      ad_group == 2 ~ "Emotion",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("Control", "Reason", "Emotion"))
  )
```

### DATA EXPLORATION

```{r}
#Check missing values 
col_missing <- sapply(data, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
#Check duplciated values 
duplicated_rows <- sum(duplicated(data))
duplicaed_id <- sum(duplicated(data$participant_id))
#Check unique values for each columns 
unique_values <- sapply(data, unique)
#Summary 
summary <- summary(data)
```

### DATA PROCESSING

Include 1)Transform select all that apply variables into dummy variables; 2)Reverse Likert scale scores for negative-feeling questions

```{r}
# Transform select all that apply variables into dummary variables 
# Identify all unique emotion responses
unique_emotions <- data %>% 
  pull(ad_emotion) %>% 
  str_split(", ") %>% 
  unlist() %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  na.omit()

# Create dummy variables for each emotion
for (emotion in unique_emotions) {
  # Clean the emotion name to create valid column names
  col_name <- emotion %>% 
    tolower() %>% 
    str_replace_all("[^a-z]", "_") %>% 
    str_replace_all("_+", "_") %>% 
    str_remove("_$")
  
  data <- data %>% 
    mutate(!!col_name := as.integer(str_detect(ad_emotion, fixed(emotion))))
}

# Reverse Likert scale scores for negative-feeling questions
# Identify all negative-feeling Likert scale columns
likert_negative <- c(
"external_pressure", "judged", "bad_reaction","variant_concern", "safety_concern","conflicting_info","short_term_effects", "long_term_effects",
  "risk_exaggerated", "preventive_measures", "access_delay", "incentives_help") #Statements with negative feelings like "I worry about being judged for my vaccination choices." 

negative_cols <- c(likert_negative, paste0(likert_negative, "_endline"))

# Function to reverse Likert scale scores
reverse_likert <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), NA, 6 - x)
}

# Apply the reversal to all negative-feeling columns
data <- data %>% 
  mutate(across(any_of(negative_cols), reverse_likert))
```

```{r}
write_csv(data, "../data/processed/full_data_cleaned.csv")
```
